properties.description:
SVRBIS

The National Weather Service in Bismarck has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Ward County in north central North Dakota...

* Until 530 AM CDT.

* At 450 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 9 miles north of
Max, or 20 miles south of Minot, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Sawyer and Logan.

windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...East Central Monroe County in western New York...

* WHEN...Until 945 PM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of Irondequoit Creek and other low-lying and
flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. This will include
Ellison Park, with water levels possibly effecting Blossom Road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 946 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is expected on Irondequoit Creek in the
warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches are possible in
the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Irondequoit, East Rochester, Fairport, Brighton and Penfield.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

address into your favorite web browser URL bar:

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 3 at 5:51AM EDT until September 3 at 6:30AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SVRCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South central Erie County in northwestern Pennsylvania...
Crawford County in northwestern Pennsylvania...

* Until 630 AM EDT.

* At 551 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Meadville,
moving east at 55 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to vehicles is possible. Expect damage to
trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Meadville, Titusville, Cambridge Springs, Linesville, Adamsville,
Canadohta Lake, Riceville, Harmonsburg, Lincolnville, Guys Mills,
Atlantic, Pymatuning Central, Cochranton, Saegertown,
Conneautville, Conneaut Lake, Jamestown, Hydetown, Springboro, and
Blooming Valley.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 3 at 4:21AM CDT until September 3 at 6:45AM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Southwestern Polk County in southeastern Texas...
Central San Jacinto County in southeastern Texas...

* WHEN...Until 645 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable
especially along FM 3128 northeast of Coldspring and SH 150 west of
Shepherd.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 418 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly in the warned area. Between 3 and 6 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, and monitoring approaching
scattered showers. Flash Flood Guidance is very low in this area
due to previous rounds of rainfall, especially near Coldspring.
Additional rainfall this morning would likely warrant an upgrade
back to a Flash Flood Warning.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Shepherd, Coldspring and Lake Livingston State Park.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
